title: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation
section_heading: Apple Inc: Flagship Products and Services
context_header: Source Document: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation > Section: Apple Inc: Flagship Products and Services
text:
Source Document: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation > Section: Apple Inc: Flagship Products and Services

Apple designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. Flagship hardware lines include the iPhone, Mac personal computers (MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, Mac Studio), iPad tablets, and the Apple Watch wearable series.

title: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation
context_header: Source Document: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation > Section: iPhone Product Family
text:
Source Document: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation > Section: iPhone Product Family

The iPhone product family represents Apple's premier smartphone lineup, featuring cutting-edge Apple Silicon A-series processors, Super Retina XDR OLED displays, Ceramic Shield protection, and advanced multi-lens camera systems with optical image stabilization and ProRes video recording.

title: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation
context_header: Source Document: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation > Section: Mac Computers and Apple Silicon
text:
Source Document: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation > Section: Mac Computers and Apple Silicon

Apple Silicon (M-series processors including M3, M4, and M4 Pro) powers the Mac ecosystem, delivering industry-leading performance-per-watt, unified memory architecture, and extended battery life across MacBook Air and MacBook Pro.

title: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation

text:
Source Document: Apple - Hardware, Software, Services and Innovation > Section: Apple Services and Subscription Platforms

Apple's services portfolio encompasses the App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV+, Apple Pay, iCloud+, and Apple Care, providing seamless cloud storage, entertainment, and digital payments across Apple devices.
